nugetCli.code:
dotnet nuget add source {{SITE_URL}}/nuget/index.json --name liquid-glass
dotnet add package {{NUGET_ID}} --version {{VERSION}}

pluginShell.code:
claude plugin marketplace add rookasrudzianskas/liquid-glass-mac-windows-ios-android
claude plugin install liquid-glass@liquid-glass-engineering

skillsManual.code:
curl -LO {{SITE_URL}}/downloads/liquid-glass-skills.zip

# Claude Code
unzip liquid-glass-skills.zip -d ~/.claude/skills
# Codex and other Agent Skills tools
unzip liquid-glass-skills.zip -d ~/.agents/skills

verify.code:
# In the folder with your downloads
curl -LO {{SITE_URL}}/downloads/SHA256SUMS

# macOS
shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing
# Linux
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing
# Windows PowerShell (SHA-256 by default)
Get-FileHash .\LiquidGlassStudio-win-x64.zip
